answer_1.quote: We normalize and optimize state legislative data by using Generative LLMs, e.g., OpenAI GPT ... This involves generating consistent summaries of bills ...
answer_1.outputs: Bill highlights (concise summaries) with identified winners and losers

answer_4.quote: We used MTurk to identify the stakeholders who would gain or lose from the bills' policy ... We assigned 3 annotators from our pool to each bill highlight ... and asked them to assess the impact of bill policies on the stakeholders.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated the impact of each bill on identified stakeholders, determining winners and losers.
